query:
-- Check data counts and formatting integrity
SELECT 
  'dashboard_items' as table_name,
  COUNT(*) as total_records,
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_bold_text,
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%[%](%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_hyperlinks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_items
FROM dashboard_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'software_items',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%[%](%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM software_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'systems_items',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%[%](%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM systems_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'decisions',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN decision_outcome LIKE '%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN decision_outcome LIKE '%[%](%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
FROM decisions
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'milestones',
  COUNT(*),
  0,
  0,
  0
FROM milestones
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'upcoming_reviews',
  COUNT(*),
  0,
  0,
  0
FROM upcoming_reviews;
